def register(
    registration: Path = DEFAULT_REGISTRATION,
    roster_path: Path = DEFAULT_ROSTER,
    fixed_sources_path: Path = DEFAULT_FIXED_SOURCES,
    *,
    capacity_registration_path: Path = DEFAULT_CAPACITY_REGISTRATION,
    capacity_result_path: Path = DEFAULT_CAPACITY_RESULT,
    previous_roster_path: Path = DEFAULT_PREVIOUS_ROSTER,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Freeze the queue roster and protocol without reading any joint outcome."""

    registration = Path(registration)
    roster_path = Path(roster_path)
    fixed_sources_path = Path(fixed_sources_path)
    if any(path.exists() for path in (registration, roster_path, fixed_sources_path)):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("static-screen registration artifacts already exist")
    source = _read_object(Path(capacity_registration_path))
    source_contract = _capacity_registration_contract(source)
    previous_payload = _read_object(Path(previous_roster_path))
    previous = _validated_previous_roster(previous_payload)
    roster = generate_roster(previous)
    protocol = {
        "registered_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        **_protocol_constants(
            capacity_registration_path=Path(capacity_registration_path),
            capacity_result_path=Path(capacity_result_path),
            previous_roster_path=Path(previous_roster_path),
            source_contract=source_contract,
            previous_roster=previous_payload,
            roster=roster,
        ),
    }
    _write_new(roster_path, roster, compact=True)
    _write_new(fixed_sources_path, _current_fixed_sources())
    _write_new(registration, protocol, compact=True)
    return protocol


def _validate_roster(
    roster: Mapping[str, Any], protocol: Mapping[str, Any]
) -> tuple[tuple[int, int, int], ...]:
    contract = protocol.get("queue_roster_contract") or {}
    queues = tuple(tuple(int(value) for value in row) for row in roster.get("queues") or ())
    previous = {
        tuple(int(value) for value in row)
        for row in (contract.get("previous_512_roster") or {}).get("queues") or ()
    }
    old_grid = _old_base_grid()
    valid = (
        roster.get("schema_version") == 1
        and roster.get("experiment") == EXPERIMENT
        and roster.get("seed") == ROSTER_SEED
        and roster.get("coordinate_ranges_inclusive")
        == [list(bounds) for bounds in ROSTER_RANGES]
        and roster.get("requested_queue_count") == ROSTER_SIZE
        and roster.get("candidate_draws") == contract.get("candidate_draws")
        and roster.get("rng_integer_draws") == contract.get("rng_integer_draws")
        and roster.get("queues") == contract.get("base_queues")
        and len(queues) == len(set(queues)) == ROSTER_SIZE
        and len(previous) == ROSTER_SIZE
        and all(
            queue != (0, 0, 0)
            and queue not in old_grid
            and queue not in previous
            and len(queue) == len(ROSTER_RANGES)
            and all(
                lower <= value <= upper
                for value, (lower, upper) in zip(queue, ROSTER_RANGES, strict=True)
            )
            for queue in queues
        )
        and roster.get("old_1000_grid_intersection_count") == 0
        and roster.get("prior_512_roster_intersection_count") == 0
    )
    if not valid:
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("registered static-screen queue roster changed or is invalid")
    return queues


def _validate_protocol(protocol: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    if (
        protocol.get("schema_version") != 1
        or protocol.get("gate") != GATE
        or protocol.get("experiment") != EXPERIMENT
        or protocol.get("status") != REGISTRATION_STATUS
        or protocol.get("registered") is not True
        or protocol.get("decision_rule") != DECISION_RULE
        or protocol.get("claim_boundary") != CLAIM_BOUNDARY
        or protocol.get("prohibited") != PROHIBITED
    ):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("static-screen registration is invalid")
    audit = protocol.get("uniform_margin_scaling_audit") or {}
    if (
        audit.get("all_nine_action_durations_uniformly_scaled") is not True
        or audit.get("issue_count") != 0
        or audit.get("joint_result_values_read") is not False
        or audit.get("capacity_outcome_read") is not False
    ):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("registered common-margin scaling audit is invalid")


def _runtime_context(protocol: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Revalidate complete joint evidence before accepting the closure result."""

    paths = protocol.get("source_paths") or {}
    source_path = Path(paths["capacity_closure_registration"])
    source = _read_object(source_path)
    contract = _capacity_registration_contract(source)
    if contract != protocol.get("capacity_closure_registration_contract"):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("capacity-closure registration changed after static registration")
    if _uniform_margin_scaling_audit(source) != protocol.get("uniform_margin_scaling_audit"):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("common-margin scaling audit changed after registration")

    try:
        current = closure._current_source_snapshot(source)
        closure._validate_registered_sources(source, current)
        joint = closure._complete_joint_evidence(source, current["manifest"])
    except (closure.ClosureRefusal, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise StaticScreenRefusal(
            f"joint95 calibration/release/holdout evidence is incomplete or invalid: {exc}"
        ) from exc
    if (
        joint.get("release", {}).get("audit_passed") is not True
        or joint.get("holdout_covered") is not True
        or len(joint.get("calibration") or ()) != 19
        or int((joint.get("holdout") or {}).get("joint_wave", -1)) != closure.HOLDOUT_WAVE
    ):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("joint95 complete-evidence coverage audit did not pass")

    capacity_result = _read_object(Path(paths["capacity_closure_result"]))
    if (
        capacity_result.get("schema_version") != 1
        or capacity_result.get("gate") != CAPACITY_GATE
        or capacity_result.get("experiment") != CAPACITY_EXPERIMENT
        or capacity_result.get("status") != "PASS"
        or capacity_result.get("protocol") != source
        or capacity_result.get("joint95_audit") != joint
    ):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("capacity-closure artifact does not match the complete joint audit")

    margin = float(joint["one_sided_margin"])
    envelope_model, envelopes = closure._planned_baseline_model(
        current["point_model"],
        source["predictor_anchor"],
        source["action_mapping"],
        margin=margin,
    )
    expected_model = _json(envelope_model.snapshot())
    physical = capacity_result.get("physical_complete_frame_envelope") or {}
    if physical.get("model") != expected_model or physical.get("actions") != _json(envelopes):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("capacity-closure artifact changed the joint-envelope catalogue")
    recomputed_capacity = closure._capacity_analysis(source, envelope_model)
    if capacity_result.get("capacity") != recomputed_capacity:
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("capacity-closure capacity analysis does not reproduce")
    scale = float(recomputed_capacity["common_capacity_scale"])
    if not math.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0.0:
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("final joint-envelope common capacity boundary is not positive")

    # This screen intentionally does not consult capacity_established or the old
    # point-normalized all_registered_capacity_margins_positive field.
    return {
        "source": source,
        "joint": joint,
        "capacity_closure": capacity_result,
        "envelope_model": envelope_model,
        "envelopes": envelopes,
        "common_capacity_scale": scale,
    }


def _physical_capacity_rows(
    source: Mapping[str, Any], model: FrameModel, common_scale: float
) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    capacity = source.get("fixed_capacity_contract") or {}
    base = tuple(float(value) for value in capacity["fixed_point_boundary_arrivals_base_R2"])
    result: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for lanes in LANE_COUNTS:
        lane_model = replace(model, lanes=lanes)
        structural = capacity_certificate(lane_model, LOADS[0])
        boundary = tuple(common_scale * lanes / 2 * value for value in base)
        rows = []
        for load in LOADS:
            arrivals = tuple(load * value for value in boundary)
            slack = _uniform_capacity_slack(lane_model, arrivals, structural)
            rows.append({
                "lanes": lanes,
                "load": load,
                "load_normalization": "fraction_of_final_joint_envelope_common_capacity_boundary",
                "common_capacity_scale": common_scale,
                "common_boundary_arrival_rates": list(boundary),
                **slack,
                "capacity_projection_passed": bool(structural["capacity_projection_passed"]),
                "positive_effective_slack": (
                    bool(structural["capacity_projection_passed"])
                    and float(slack["effective_slack_eta"]) > SCORE_TOLERANCE
                ),
            })
        result[str(lanes)] = rows
    return result


def _certificate_valid(selection: CountSpaceBnbSelection, queue: Sequence[int]) -> bool:
    queue_norm = sum(queue)
    return (
        selection.score <= selection.upper_bound + SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and selection.gap >= -SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and math.isclose(
            selection.gap,
            max(0.0, selection.upper_bound - selection.score),
            rel_tol=0.0,
            abs_tol=SCORE_TOLERANCE,
        )
        and math.isclose(
            selection.epsilon,
            selection.gap / queue_norm if queue_norm else 0.0,
            rel_tol=0.0,
            abs_tol=SCORE_TOLERANCE,
        )
        and selection.dual_certified_lp_calls + selection.safe_fallback_lp_calls
        == selection.lp_calls
    )


def _work_row(selection: CountSpaceBnbSelection) -> dict[str, int]:
    return {
        "lp_calls": int(selection.lp_calls),
        "lp_matrix_coefficients": int(selection.lp_matrix_coefficients),
        "candidate_evaluations": int(selection.candidate_evaluations),
        "residual_fill_option_probes": int(selection.residual_fill_option_probes),
        "dual_column_checks": int(selection.dual_column_checks),
    }


def _add_work(target: dict[str, int], selection: CountSpaceBnbSelection) -> None:
    for key, value in _work_row(selection).items():
        target[key] += value


def _new_work() -> dict[str, int]:
    return {
        "lp_calls": 0,
        "lp_matrix_coefficients": 0,
        "candidate_evaluations": 0,
        "residual_fill_option_probes": 0,
        "dual_column_checks": 0,
    }


def _selection_witness(
    base_queue: Sequence[int],
    queue: Sequence[int],
    candidate: CountSpaceBnbSelection,
    reference: CountSpaceBnbSelection,
    value: float,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "base_queue": list(base_queue),
        "scaled_queue": list(queue),
        "queue_l1": sum(queue),
        "value": value,
        "candidate": {
            "option_counts": list(candidate.option_counts),
            "score": candidate.score,
            "upper_bound": candidate.upper_bound,
            "gap": candidate.gap,
            "epsilon": candidate.epsilon,
            "exact": candidate.exact,
            "work": _work_row(candidate),
        },
        "cold_reference": {
            "option_counts": list(reference.option_counts),
            "score": reference.score,
            "upper_bound": reference.upper_bound,
            "gap": reference.gap,
            "epsilon": reference.epsilon,
            "exact": reference.exact,
            "work": _work_row(reference),
        },
    }


def _screen_lane(
    model: FrameModel,
    base_queues: Sequence[Sequence[int]],
    lanes: int,
    capacity_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, bool]]:
    budget = FIXED_BUDGET_BY_LANE[lanes]
    factor = lanes // 2
    candidate_work = _new_work()
    reference_work = _new_work()
    max_epsilon = -1.0
    max_regret = -1.0
    epsilon_witness = None
    regret_witness = None
    candidate_exact_count = 0
    action_match_count = 0
    valid_candidate_count = 0
    valid_reference_count = 0
    regret_bounded_count = 0

    for base_queue in base_queues:
        queue = tuple(factor * int(value) for value in base_queue)
        candidate = select_count_space_bnb_frame(model.options, queue, lanes, budget)
        reference = select_count_space_bnb_frame(
            model.options, queue, lanes, EXACT_REFERENCE_BUDGET
        )
        candidate_valid = (
            _selection_reconstructs(model, queue, lanes, candidate)
            and _selection_work_holds(queue, lanes, budget, candidate)
            and _certificate_valid(candidate, queue)
        )
        reference_valid = (
            _selection_reconstructs(model, queue, lanes, reference)
            and _selection_work_holds(
                queue, lanes, EXACT_REFERENCE_BUDGET, reference
            )
            and _certificate_valid(reference, queue)
            and reference.exact
            and math.isclose(
                reference.score,
                reference.upper_bound,
                rel_tol=0.0,
                abs_tol=SCORE_TOLERANCE,
            )
        )
        queue_norm = sum(queue)
        regret = (reference.score - candidate.score) / queue_norm
        regret_bounded = (
            regret >= -SCORE_TOLERANCE
            and regret <= candidate.epsilon + SCORE_TOLERANCE
        )
        candidate_exact_count += int(candidate.exact)
        action_match_count += int(candidate.option_counts == reference.option_counts)
        valid_candidate_count += int(candidate_valid)
        valid_reference_count += int(reference_valid)
        regret_bounded_count += int(regret_bounded)
        _add_work(candidate_work, candidate)
        _add_work(reference_work, reference)
        if candidate.epsilon > max_epsilon:
            max_epsilon = candidate.epsilon
            epsilon_witness = _selection_witness(
                base_queue, queue, candidate, reference, candidate.epsilon
            )
        if regret > max_regret:
            max_regret = regret
            regret_witness = _selection_witness(
                base_queue, queue, candidate, reference, regret
            )

    compute_comparisons = {
        key: {
            "candidate": candidate_work[key],
            "cold_exact_reference": reference_work[key],
            "candidate_fraction_of_reference": (
                candidate_work[key] / reference_work[key]
                if reference_work[key]
                else None
            ),
            "strictly_lower": candidate_work[key] < reference_work[key],
        }
        for key in ("lp_calls", "lp_matrix_coefficients", "candidate_evaluations")
    }
    support_rows = []
    for capacity in capacity_rows:
        eta = float(capacity["effective_slack_eta"])
        epsilon_residual = eta - max_epsilon
        regret_residual = eta - max_regret
        support_rows.append({
            "lanes": lanes,
            "load": float(capacity["load"]),
            "load_normalization": capacity["load_normalization"],
            "arrival_rates": _json(capacity["arrival_rates"]),
            "effective_slack_eta": eta,
            "maximum_candidate_epsilon": max_epsilon,
            "maximum_actual_normalized_action_regret": max_regret,
            "eta_minus_candidate_epsilon": epsilon_residual,
            "eta_minus_actual_action_regret": regret_residual,
            "candidate_epsilon_strictly_below_eta": (
                epsilon_residual > SCORE_TOLERANCE
            ),
            "actual_action_regret_strictly_below_eta": (
                regret_residual > SCORE_TOLERANCE
            ),
            "support_residual_gate_passed": (
                capacity["capacity_projection_passed"]
                and epsilon_residual > SCORE_TOLERANCE
                and regret_residual > SCORE_TOLERANCE
            ),
        })
    lane_checks = {
        "scaled_queue_construction_count_is_exact": len(base_queues) == ROSTER_SIZE,
        "every_candidate_certificate_valid": valid_candidate_count == ROSTER_SIZE,
        "every_cold_reference_is_valid_and_exact": valid_reference_count == ROSTER_SIZE,
        "every_actual_regret_is_nonnegative_and_bounded_by_epsilon": (
            regret_bounded_count == ROSTER_SIZE
        ),
    }
    support_gate_passed = all(
        row["support_residual_gate_passed"] for row in support_rows
    )
    compute_gate_passed = all(
        row["strictly_lower"] for row in compute_comparisons.values()
    )
    return ({
        "lanes": lanes,
        "queue_scale": factor,
        "state_count": len(base_queues),
        "fixed_lp_budget": budget,
        "cold_exact_reference_budget": EXACT_REFERENCE_BUDGET,
        "raw_ordered_actions_per_state": LOCAL_CHOICE_COUNT**lanes,
        "represented_count_vectors_per_state": math.comb(OPTION_COUNT + lanes, lanes),
        "candidate_exact_state_count": candidate_exact_count,
        "candidate_action_matches_reference_count": action_match_count,
        "valid_candidate_certificate_count": valid_candidate_count,
        "valid_exact_reference_count": valid_reference_count,
        "regret_bounded_by_epsilon_count": regret_bounded_count,
        "maximum_candidate_epsilon": max_epsilon,
        "maximum_actual_normalized_action_regret": max_regret,
        "epsilon_witness": epsilon_witness,
        "action_regret_witness": regret_witness,
        "support_by_physical_load": support_rows,
        "candidate_actual_work": candidate_work,
        "cold_reference_actual_work": reference_work,
        "actual_compute_comparison": compute_comparisons,
        "checks": lane_checks,
        "support_gate_passed": support_gate_passed,
        "actual_compute_gate_passed": compute_gate_passed,
    }, lane_checks)


def _decision(execution_passed: bool, lanes: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], aggregate_compute: bool) -> str:
    if not execution_passed:
        return "INVALID_EXECUTION"
    if not all(row["support_gate_passed"] for row in lanes):
        return "STATIC_SUPPORT_FAIL_STOP"
    if not aggregate_compute or not all(row["actual_compute_gate_passed"] for row in lanes):
        return "STATIC_COMPUTE_FAIL_STOP"
    return "STATIC_SUPPORT_AND_COMPUTE_PASS_ADVANCE_TO_SEPARATE_PHYSICAL_TRAJECTORY"


def run_registered(
    registration: Path = DEFAULT_REGISTRATION,
    roster_path: Path = DEFAULT_ROSTER,
    fixed_sources_path: Path = DEFAULT_FIXED_SOURCES,
    output: Path = DEFAULT_RESULT,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    output = Path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise StaticScreenRefusal(f"static-screen result already exists: {output}")
    protocol = _read_object(Path(registration))
    _validate_protocol(protocol)
    roster_payload = _read_object(Path(roster_path))
    base_queues = _validate_roster(roster_payload, protocol)
    fixed_sources = _read_object(Path(fixed_sources_path))
    if fixed_sources != _current_fixed_sources():
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("registered static-screen sources changed")

    # Do not invoke capacity or selector code until the future joint evidence
    # and the matching capacity-closure artifact are complete and valid.
    context = _runtime_context(protocol)
    model = context["envelope_model"]
    if (
        len(model.options) != OPTION_COUNT
        or len(set(max(1.0, option.duration) for option in model.options)) != OPTION_COUNT
    ):
        raise StaticScreenRefusal("joint envelope does not retain nine duration roots")
    capacity_by_lane = _physical_capacity_rows(
        context["source"], model, context["common_capacity_scale"]
    )

    started = time.perf_counter()
    lane_rows = []
    lane_checks = []
    for lanes in LANE_COUNTS:
        row, checks = _screen_lane(
            model, base_queues, lanes, capacity_by_lane[str(lanes)]
        )
        lane_rows.append(row)
        lane_checks.append(checks)

    candidate_total = _new_work()
    reference_total = _new_work()
    for row in lane_rows:
        for key in candidate_total:
            candidate_total[key] += row["candidate_actual_work"][key]
            reference_total[key] += row["cold_reference_actual_work"][key]
    aggregate_comparisons = {
        key: {
            "candidate": candidate_total[key],
            "cold_exact_reference": reference_total[key],
            "candidate_fraction_of_reference": (
                candidate_total[key] / reference_total[key]
                if reference_total[key]
                else None
            ),
            "strictly_lower": candidate_total[key] < reference_total[key],
        }
        for key in ("lp_calls", "lp_matrix_coefficients", "candidate_evaluations")
    }
    aggregate_compute = all(row["strictly_lower"] for row in aggregate_comparisons.values())
    checks = {
        "registered_roster_is_explicit_unique_and_disjoint": len(base_queues) == ROSTER_SIZE,
        "joint95_calibration_release_holdout_and_coverage_revalidated": True,
        "matching_capacity_closure_artifact_reproduced": True,
        "common_margin_uniformly_scales_all_nine_durations": True,
        "old_point_load_capacity_gate_not_used": True,
        "physical_loads_are_common_boundary_normalized": all(
            row["load_normalization"]
            == "fraction_of_final_joint_envelope_common_capacity_boundary"
            for rows in capacity_by_lane.values()
            for row in rows
        ),
        "every_lane_execution_check_passes": all(
            all(row.values()) for row in lane_checks
        ),
        "selector_call_count_is_exact": (
            sum(row["state_count"] for row in lane_rows)
            == ROSTER_SIZE * len(LANE_COUNTS)
        ),
        "no_ordered_or_count_vector_enumeration": True,
        "no_run_rng_arrivals_or_trajectories": True,
    }
    execution_passed = all(checks.values())
    decision = _decision(execution_passed, lane_rows, aggregate_compute)
    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "gate": GATE,
        "experiment": EXPERIMENT,
        "status": "PASS" if execution_passed else "FAIL",
        "registration_path": str(Path(registration).resolve()),
        "protocol": protocol,
        "checks": checks,
        "joint95_dependency": {
            "capacity_closure_result": str(
                Path(protocol["source_paths"]["capacity_closure_result"]).resolve()
            ),
            "one_sided_margin": context["joint"]["one_sided_margin"],
            "holdout_covered": context["joint"]["holdout_covered"],
            "common_capacity_scale": context["common_capacity_scale"],
            "old_point_load_capacity_gate_consulted": False,
        },
        "physical_complete_frame_envelope": {
            "model": _json(model.snapshot()),
            "actions": _json(context["envelopes"]),
        },
        "physical_capacity_normalized_loads": capacity_by_lane,
        "lane_summaries": lane_rows,
        "aggregate_actual_compute": {
            "candidate": candidate_total,
            "cold_exact_reference": reference_total,
            "comparison": aggregate_comparisons,
            "gate_passed": aggregate_compute,
        },
        "work_accounting": {
            "candidate_selector_calls": ROSTER_SIZE * len(LANE_COUNTS),
            "cold_reference_selector_calls": ROSTER_SIZE * len(LANE_COUNTS),
            "capacity_structural_calls": len(LANE_COUNTS),
            "capacity_slack_calls": len(LANE_COUNTS) * len(LOADS),
            "ordered_action_evaluations": 0,
            "count_vector_enumerations": 0,
            "run_rng_initializations": 0,
            "arrival_tapes": 0,
            "trajectory_frames": 0,
        },
        "scientific_decision": decision,
        "physical_trajectory_advance": (
            decision
            == "STATIC_SUPPORT_AND_COMPUTE_PASS_ADVANCE_TO_SEPARATE_PHYSICAL_TRAJECTORY"
        ),
        "claim_boundary": CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
        "next_step": (
            "register a separate physical-time paired trajectory before execution"
            if decision
            == "STATIC_SUPPORT_AND_COMPUTE_PASS_ADVANCE_TO_SEPARATE_PHYSICAL_TRAJECTORY"
            else "preserve this finite-roster outcome and do not tune on its queues"
        ),
        "timing": {
            "total_screen_wall_s": time.perf_counter() - started,
            "timing_is_scientific_gate": False,
        },
    }
    _write_new(output, report)
    return report


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    register_parser = sub.add_parser("register")
    register_parser.add_argument("--registration", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_REGISTRATION)
    register_parser.add_argument("--roster", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_ROSTER)
    register_parser.add_argument("--fixed-sources", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_FIXED_SOURCES)
    register_parser.add_argument(
        "--capacity-registration", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CAPACITY_REGISTRATION
    )
    register_parser.add_argument("--capacity-result", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CAPACITY_RESULT)
    register_parser.add_argument("--previous-roster", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_PREVIOUS_ROSTER)
    run_parser = sub.add_parser("run")
    run_parser.add_argument("--registration", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_REGISTRATION)
    run_parser.add_argument("--roster", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_ROSTER)
    run_parser.add_argument("--fixed-sources", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_FIXED_SOURCES)
    run_parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_RESULT)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "register":
            payload = register(
                args.registration,
                args.roster,
                args.fixed_sources,
                capacity_registration_path=args.capacity_registration,
                capacity_result_path=args.capacity_result,
                previous_roster_path=args.previous_roster,
            )
            output = args.registration
        else:
            payload = run_registered(
                args.registration, args.roster, args.fixed_sources, args.output
            )
            output = args.output
    except StaticScreenRefusal as exc:
        parser.exit(2, f"REFUSED: {exc}\n")
    print(json.dumps({
        "experiment": payload["experiment"],
        "status": payload.get("status", REGISTRATION_STATUS),
        "scientific_decision": payload.get("scientific_decision"),
        "output": str(output),
    }))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class V5CanonicalScreenRefusal(RuntimeError):
    """The v5 data gate or frozen canonical-screen contract is not satisfied."""


def _json(value: Any) -> Any:
    return json.loads(json.dumps(value))


def _read_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        value = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal(f"cannot read JSON object {path}: {exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal(f"JSON root must be an object: {path}")
    return value


def _write_new(path: Path, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(dict(payload), stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")


def _capacity_contract(source: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    paths = source.get("source_paths") or {}
    scope = source.get("registration_scope") or {}
    capacity = source.get("fixed_capacity_contract") or {}
    if (
        source.get("schema_version") != 1
        or source.get("gate") != CAPACITY_GATE
        or source.get("experiment") != CAPACITY_EXPERIMENT
        or source.get("status") != "REGISTERED_AWAITING_JOINT95_V5_DATA"
        or source.get("registered") is not True
        or Path(str(paths.get("collection_manifest") or "")).resolve()
        != DEFAULT_COLLECTION_MANIFEST.resolve()
        or Path(str(paths.get("joint_results_directory") or "")).resolve()
        != DEFAULT_RESULTS_DIR.resolve()
        or capacity.get("capacity_lanes") != list(base.LANE_COUNTS)
        or capacity.get("loads") != list(base.LOADS)
        or scope.get("v5_joint_visit_values_read") is not False
        or scope.get("v5_joint_results_directory_read") is not False
    ):
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("joint95 v5 capacity registration is invalid")
    return _json(source)


def _reused_roster_contract() -> dict[str, Any]:
    legacy_protocol = _read_object(DEFAULT_LEGACY_REGISTRATION)
    base._validate_protocol(legacy_protocol)
    roster = _read_object(DEFAULT_REUSED_ROSTER)
    queues = base._validate_roster(roster, legacy_protocol)
    if (
        roster.get("seed") != base.ROSTER_SEED
        or len(queues) != base.ROSTER_SIZE
        or base.ROSTER_SEED != 13041
    ):
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("reused canonical roster differs")
    return {
        "path": str(DEFAULT_REUSED_ROSTER.resolve()),
        "seed": base.ROSTER_SEED,
        "size": base.ROSTER_SIZE,
        "candidate_draws": roster.get("candidate_draws"),
        "coordinate_ranges_inclusive": _json(roster.get("coordinate_ranges_inclusive")),
        "queues": [list(queue) for queue in queues],
        "reuse_role": "fixed design object only; no v1 joint observation is reused",
    }


def _load_reused_queues(contract: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
    roster = _read_object(Path(str(contract.get("path") or "")))
    queues = tuple(tuple(int(value) for value in row) for row in roster.get("queues") or ())
    if (
        roster.get("seed") != 13041
        or contract.get("seed") != 13041
        or contract.get("size") != 512
        or roster.get("candidate_draws") != contract.get("candidate_draws")
        or roster.get("coordinate_ranges_inclusive")
        != contract.get("coordinate_ranges_inclusive")
        or [list(queue) for queue in queues] != contract.get("queues")
        or len(queues) != 512
        or len(set(queues)) != 512
    ):
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("reused seed-13041 roster changed")
    return queues

def register(
    registration: Path = DEFAULT_REGISTRATION,
    fixed_sources: Path = DEFAULT_FIXED_SOURCES,
    *,
    capacity_registration: Path = DEFAULT_CAPACITY_REGISTRATION,
    capacity_result: Path = DEFAULT_CAPACITY_RESULT,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if any(Path(path).exists() for path in (registration, fixed_sources, DEFAULT_RESULT)):
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("v5 canonical-screen artifacts already exist")
    capacity_contract = _capacity_contract(_read_object(Path(capacity_registration)))
    protocol = {
        "registered_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        **_protocol(
            capacity_registration=capacity_registration,
            capacity_result=capacity_result,
            capacity_contract=capacity_contract,
            roster_contract=_reused_roster_contract(),
        ),
    }
    _write_new(Path(registration), protocol)
    _write_new(Path(fixed_sources), _current_fixed_sources())
    return protocol


def _validate_protocol(protocol: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    selector = protocol.get("selector_contract") or {}
    gate = protocol.get("v5_data_gate") or {}
    v1 = protocol.get("v1_contribution") or {}
    v2 = protocol.get("v2_contribution") or {}
    v3 = protocol.get("v3_contribution") or {}
    v4 = protocol.get("v4_contribution") or {}
    if (
        protocol.get("schema_version") != 1
        or protocol.get("gate") != GATE
        or protocol.get("experiment") != EXPERIMENT
        or protocol.get("status") != REGISTRATION_STATUS
        or protocol.get("registered") is not True
        or selector.get("fixed_budget_by_lane") != {"8": 36, "16": 72}
        or selector.get("cold_canonical_reference_budget") != 4096
        or gate.get("calibration_waves") != list(range(94, 113))
        or gate.get("holdout_wave") != 113
        or any(v1.get(key) != 0 for key in ("joint_units", "joint_scores", "capacity_rows", "holdout_rows"))
        or any(v2.get(key) != 0 for key in ("joint_units", "joint_scores", "capacity_rows", "holdout_rows"))
        or any(v3.get(key) != 0 for key in ("joint_units", "joint_scores", "capacity_rows", "holdout_rows"))
        or any(v4.get(key) != 0 for key in ("joint_units", "joint_scores", "capacity_rows", "holdout_rows"))
    ):
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("v5 canonical-screen registration changed")


def require_v5_complete(protocol: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    paths = protocol.get("source_paths") or {}
    manifest = v5_dispatcher.load_registered_manifest(Path(paths["collection_manifest"]))
    state = v5_dispatcher.collection_status(
        manifest, Path(paths["joint_results_directory"])
    )
    complete = (
        state.get("status") == "COMPLETE"
        and state.get("errors") == []
        and state.get("successful_calibration_count") == 19
        and state.get("holdout_released") is True
        and state.get("holdout_success") is True
        and state.get("next_wave") is None
    )
    if not complete:
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal(
            "joint95 v5 collection is incomplete at the data gate: "
            f"status={state.get('status')!r}, calibration="
            f"{state.get('successful_calibration_count')!r}"
        )
    return state


def run_registered(
    registration: Path = DEFAULT_REGISTRATION,
    fixed_sources: Path = DEFAULT_FIXED_SOURCES,
    output: Path = DEFAULT_RESULT,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    output = Path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal(f"result already exists: {output}")
    protocol = _read_object(Path(registration))
    _validate_protocol(protocol)
    if _read_object(Path(fixed_sources)) != _current_fixed_sources():
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("registered v5 canonical-screen sources changed")
    collection = require_v5_complete(protocol)

    paths = protocol["source_paths"]
    capacity_protocol = _read_object(Path(paths["capacity_registration"]))
    if _capacity_contract(capacity_protocol) != protocol["capacity_registration_contract"]:
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("v5 capacity registration changed")
    capacity = _read_object(Path(paths["capacity_result"]))
    if (
        capacity.get("gate") != CAPACITY_GATE
        or capacity.get("experiment") != CAPACITY_EXPERIMENT
        or capacity.get("status") != "PASS"
        or capacity.get("protocol") != capacity_protocol
        or capacity.get("capacity_established") is not True
        or capacity.get("joint95_v5_audit", {}).get("holdout_covered") is not True
    ):
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("v5 capacity closure has not established capacity")
    snapshot = (capacity.get("physical_complete_frame_envelope") or {}).get("model")
    model = base.legacy.closure._model_from_snapshot(snapshot or {})
    scale = float((capacity.get("capacity") or {}).get("common_capacity_scale", 0.0))
    if len(model.options) != base.OPTION_COUNT or not math.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0.0:
        raise V5CanonicalScreenRefusal("v3 physical envelope is invalid")
    queues = _load_reused_queues(protocol["queue_roster_contract"])
    capacity_rows = base.legacy._physical_capacity_rows(capacity_protocol, model, scale)

    started = time.perf_counter()
    lane_rows = []
    lane_checks = []
    for lanes in base.LANE_COUNTS:
        row, checks = base._screen_lane(model, queues, lanes, capacity_rows[str(lanes)])
        lane_rows.append(row)
        lane_checks.append(checks)
    candidate_total = base._new_work()
    reference_total = base._new_work()
    for row in lane_rows:
        for field in base.WORK_FIELDS:
            candidate_total[field] += row["candidate_actual_work"][field]
            reference_total[field] += row["cold_canonical_reference_actual_work"][field]
    comparisons = {
        field: {
            "candidate": candidate_total[field],
            "cold_canonical_reference": reference_total[field],
            "strictly_lower": candidate_total[field] < reference_total[field],
        }
        for field in ("lp_calls", "lp_matrix_coefficients", "candidate_evaluations")
    }
    aggregate_compute = all(row["strictly_lower"] for row in comparisons.values())
    checks = {
        "joint95_v5_complete": True,
        "v1_joint_contribution_is_zero": True,
        "reused_seed13041_roster_has_512_queues": len(queues) == 512,
        "every_lane_execution_check_passes": all(all(row.values()) for row in lane_checks),
        "selector_call_count_is_exact": sum(row["state_count"] for row in lane_rows) == 1024,
        "no_arrivals_or_trajectories": True,
    }
    decision = base._decision(all(checks.values()), lane_rows, aggregate_compute)
    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "gate": GATE,
        "experiment": EXPERIMENT,
        "status": "PASS" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL",
        "protocol": protocol,
        "checks": checks,
        "v5_collection_status": collection,
        "v1_contribution": protocol["v1_contribution"],
        "v2_contribution": protocol["v2_contribution"],
        "v3_contribution": protocol["v3_contribution"],
        "v4_contribution": protocol["v4_contribution"],
        "physical_complete_frame_envelope": capacity["physical_complete_frame_envelope"],
        "physical_capacity_normalized_loads": capacity_rows,
        "lane_summaries": lane_rows,
        "aggregate_actual_compute": {
            "candidate": candidate_total,
            "cold_canonical_reference": reference_total,
            "comparison": comparisons,
            "gate_passed": aggregate_compute,
        },
        "scientific_decision": decision,
        "physical_trajectory_advance": decision == PASS_DECISION,
        "baseline_trajectory_advance": decision == PASS_DECISION,
        "claim_boundary": base.CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
        "timing": {"wall_s": time.perf_counter() - started, "scientific_gate": False},
    }
    _write_new(output, report)
    return report


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    action = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    action.add_argument("--register", action="store_true")
    action.add_argument("--run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--registration", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_REGISTRATION)
    parser.add_argument("--fixed-sources", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_FIXED_SOURCES)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_RESULT)
    parser.add_argument("--capacity-registration", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CAPACITY_REGISTRATION)
    parser.add_argument("--capacity-result", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CAPACITY_RESULT)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        payload = (
            register(
                args.registration,
                args.fixed_sources,
                capacity_registration=args.capacity_registration,
                capacity_result=args.capacity_result,
            )
            if args.register
            else run_registered(args.registration, args.fixed_sources, args.output)
        )
    except V5CanonicalScreenRefusal as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSED: {exc}") from exc
    print(json.dumps({"status": payload["status"], "experiment": payload["experiment"]}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def _collection_contract(
    manifest: Mapping[str, Any], *, results_dir: Path
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    coverage = manifest.get("coverage_contract") or {}
    validation = manifest.get("validation") or {}
    executor = manifest.get("executor_validation") or {}
    authorization = manifest.get("authorization_snapshot") or {}
    results = manifest.get("results_contract") or {}
    replacement = manifest.get("replacement_basis") or {}
    required = {
        "schema_version": campaign.SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "gate": campaign.GATE,
        "status": "REGISTERED_READY_FOR_SEPARATE_LAUNCH",
        "registered": True,
        "registration_only": True,
        "protocol": campaign.PROTOCOL,
        "collection_prefix": campaign.COLLECTION_PREFIX,
        "node": campaign.NODE,
        "launch_authorized": True,
        "measurements_executed": False,
        "completed_joint_units": 0,
        "evidence_status": "NO_V5_EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE",
    }
    for key, value in required.items():
        if manifest.get(key) != value:
            raise ClosureRefusal(f"v5 collection manifest {key} differs")
    if manifest.get("observations") not in ([], None):
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 registration contains empirical observations")
    if validation.get("pass") is not True or validation.get("error_count") != 0:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 collection manifest validation is not passing")
    if (
        executor.get("status") != "PASS"
        or executor.get("module") != campaign.V5_EXECUTOR_MODULE
        or executor.get("validated_scope")
        != list(campaign.V5_EXECUTOR_TEST_SCOPE)
        or executor.get("requires_nine_scheduler_interval_audits") is not True
        or executor.get("measurements_executed_before_authorization") is not False
        or executor.get("results_file_count_before_authorization") != 0
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 executor validation contract differs")
    if (
        coverage.get("calibration_joint_waves")
        != list(campaign.CALIBRATION_WAVES)
        or coverage.get("holdout_joint_wave") != campaign.HOLDOUT_WAVE
        or coverage.get("calibration_unit_count") != 19
        or coverage.get("holdout_unit_count") != 1
        or coverage.get("finite_sample_rank") != 19
        or float(coverage.get("miscoverage_alpha") or 0.0) != 0.05
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 collection coverage contract differs")

    functionals = list(manifest.get("scored_functionals") or [])
    if len(functionals) != 9 or any(
        row.get("direction") != "upper_time" for row in functionals
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 collection must contain nine upper-time functionals")
    if manifest.get("score_contract") != base.SCORE_CONTRACT:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 collection score contract differs")

    history = manifest.get("historical_training_inputs") or {}
    if (
        history.get("role") != "frozen_point_predictors_only"
        or history.get("eligible_joint_calibration_units") != 0
        or history.get("post_hoc_pairing_forbidden") is not True
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal("frozen predictor role differs")

    expected_results = Path(results_dir).resolve()
    registered_results = Path(str(results.get("results_directory") or "")).resolve()
    if registered_results != expected_results:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 results directory differs from its manifest")
    if authorization != {
        "results_directory": str(registered_results),
        "results_file_count": 0,
        "measurements_executed": False,
        "completed_joint_units": 0,
        "launch_performed": False,
    }:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 executor authorization snapshot differs")
    if (
        results.get("v5_result_prefix") != campaign.COLLECTION_PREFIX
        or results.get("v1_result_prefix_forbidden") != "critical_gpu_joint95_v1"
        or results.get("v2_result_prefix_forbidden") != "critical_gpu_joint95_v2"
        or results.get("v3_result_prefix_forbidden") != "critical_gpu_joint95_v3"
        or results.get("v4_result_prefix_forbidden") != "critical_gpu_joint95_v4"
        or results.get("premeasurement_controller_state_directory")
        != dispatcher.CONTROLLER_STATE_DIRNAME
        or results.get("campaign_fail_stop_sentinel")
        != dispatcher.FAIL_STOP_FILENAME
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 result identity or fail-stop contract differs")
    if expected_results == campaign.DEFAULT_V1_FAIL_STOP.resolve().parent:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 capacity closure cannot use the v1 results directory")
    if expected_results == campaign.DEFAULT_V2_FAIL_STOP.resolve().parent:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 capacity closure cannot use the v2 results directory")
    if expected_results == campaign.DEFAULT_V3_FAIL_STOP.resolve().parent:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 capacity closure cannot use the v3 results directory")
    if expected_results == campaign.DEFAULT_V4_RESULTS_DIR.resolve():
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 capacity closure cannot use the v4 results directory")

    zero_fields = (
        "v1_joint_units_eligible_for_v5_calibration",
        "v1_joint_units_eligible_for_v5_holdout",
        "v1_joint_scores_eligible_for_v5_margin",
        "v2_joint_units_eligible_for_v5_calibration",
        "v2_joint_units_eligible_for_v5_holdout",
        "v2_joint_scores_eligible_for_v5_margin",
        "v3_joint_units_eligible_for_v5_calibration",
        "v3_joint_units_eligible_for_v5_holdout",
        "v3_joint_scores_eligible_for_v5_margin",
        "v4_joint_units_eligible_for_v5_calibration",
        "v4_joint_units_eligible_for_v5_holdout",
        "v4_joint_scores_eligible_for_v5_margin",
    )
    if any(int(replacement.get(field, -1)) != 0 for field in zero_fields):
        raise ClosureRefusal("v1-v4 joint evidence is eligible under the v5 manifest")
    if any(replacement.get(f"v{version}_is_retry_parent") is not False for version in (1, 2, 3, 4)):
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 is incorrectly marked as a retry")

    items = list(manifest.get("joint_work_items") or [])
    expected_waves = (*campaign.CALIBRATION_WAVES, campaign.HOLDOUT_WAVE)
    if (
        len(items) != 20
        or tuple(int(row.get("joint_wave") or -1) for row in items)
        != expected_waves
        or [row.get("split_role") for row in items]
        != ["calibration"] * 19 + ["holdout"]
        or any(
            not str(row.get("joint_unit_id") or "").startswith(
                campaign.COLLECTION_PREFIX
            )
            for row in items
        )
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 joint work-item split differs")

    return {
        "schema_version": manifest["schema_version"],
        "gate": manifest["gate"],
        "status": manifest["status"],
        "registered": manifest["registered"],
        "protocol": manifest["protocol"],
        "collection_prefix": manifest["collection_prefix"],
        "node": manifest["node"],
        "node_bucket": manifest.get("node_bucket"),
        "hardware_class": manifest.get("hardware_class"),
        "coverage_contract": base._json(coverage),
        "score_contract": base._json(manifest["score_contract"]),
        "scored_functionals": base._json(functionals),
        "joint_work_items": [
            {
                "joint_wave": row["joint_wave"],
                "joint_unit_id": row["joint_unit_id"],
                "split_role": row["split_role"],
                "scored_functional_ids": base._json(
                    row.get("scored_functional_ids") or []
                ),
            }
            for row in items
        ],
        "results_contract": {
            "results_directory": str(registered_results),
            "v5_result_prefix": results["v5_result_prefix"],
            "v1_result_prefix_forbidden": results["v1_result_prefix_forbidden"],
            "v2_result_prefix_forbidden": results["v2_result_prefix_forbidden"],
            "v3_result_prefix_forbidden": results["v3_result_prefix_forbidden"],
            "v4_result_prefix_forbidden": results["v4_result_prefix_forbidden"],
            "premeasurement_controller_state_directory": results[
                "premeasurement_controller_state_directory"
            ],
            "campaign_fail_stop_sentinel": results[
                "campaign_fail_stop_sentinel"
            ],
        },
        "historical_training_inputs": {
            "empty_gate": history.get("empty_gate"),
            "loaded_gate": history.get("loaded_gate"),
            "role": history.get("role"),
            "eligible_joint_calibration_units": history.get(
                "eligible_joint_calibration_units"
            ),
            "post_hoc_pairing_forbidden": history.get(
                "post_hoc_pairing_forbidden"
            ),
        },
        "prior_joint_evidence_eligibility": {
            field: int(replacement[field]) for field in zero_fields
        },
    }

def build_registration(
    *,
    collection_manifest_path: Path = DEFAULT_COLLECTION_MANIFEST,
    results_dir: Path = DEFAULT_RESULTS_DIR,
    lcb_protocol_path: Path = DEFAULT_LCB_PROTOCOL,
    count_protocol_path: Path = DEFAULT_COUNT_PROTOCOL,
    count_result_path: Path = DEFAULT_COUNT_RESULT,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build the protocol without inspecting any joint-results directory."""

    collection_manifest_path = Path(collection_manifest_path).resolve()
    frozen_results_dir = Path(results_dir).resolve()
    lcb_protocol_path = Path(lcb_protocol_path).resolve()
    count_protocol_path = Path(count_protocol_path).resolve()
    count_result_path = Path(count_result_path).resolve()

    manifest = base._read_object(collection_manifest_path)
    collection = _collection_contract(manifest, results_dir=frozen_results_dir)
    anchor = base._predictor_anchor(manifest)
    lcb_protocol = base._read_object(lcb_protocol_path)
    count_protocol = base._read_object(count_protocol_path)
    count_result = base._read_object(count_result_path)
    if lcb_protocol.get("experiment") != "aligned_hardware_lcb_frame_envelope_shadow_v1":
        raise ClosureRefusal("LCB protocol experiment differs")
    if tuple(float(value) for value in lcb_protocol.get("loads") or ()) != base.LOADS:
        raise ClosureRefusal("LCB load roster differs")
    point_model = base._model_from_snapshot(lcb_protocol.get("point_model") or {})
    count_model = base._model_from_snapshot(count_protocol.get("model") or {})
    if point_model.snapshot() != count_model.snapshot():
        raise ClosureRefusal("LCB and count-space point-model contracts differ")
    if point_model.node != base.NODE or point_model.lanes != base.BASE_LANES:
        raise ClosureRefusal("point reference must be the registered R2 jtl110gpu2 model")
    mappings = base._action_mapping(lcb_protocol, anchor)
    baseline_model, baseline_envelopes = base._planned_baseline_model(
        point_model, anchor, mappings, margin=0.0
    )
    candidate_source = base._candidate_source_snapshot(count_protocol, count_result)
    expected_pairs = sorted(
        (int(row["lanes"]), float(row["load"]))
        for row in count_protocol.get("primary_cases") or []
    )
    if expected_pairs != [
        (lanes, load)
        for lanes in base.CAPACITY_LANES
        for load in base.CANDIDATE_LOADS
    ]:
        raise ClosureRefusal("count-space candidate lane/load roster differs")

    release_path = frozen_results_dir / "holdout_release.json"
    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "gate": GATE,
        "experiment": EXPERIMENT,
        "status": STATUS,
        "registered": True,
        "registered_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "source_paths": {
            "collection_manifest": str(collection_manifest_path),
            "joint_results_directory": str(frozen_results_dir),
            "holdout_release": str(release_path),
            "lcb_envelope_protocol": str(lcb_protocol_path),
            "count_space_trajectory_protocol": str(count_protocol_path),
            "count_space_trajectory_result": str(count_result_path),
        },
        "registration_scope": {
            "v5_joint_results_directory_read": False,
            "v5_joint_visit_values_read": False,
            "v1_joint_results_directory_read": False,
            "v1_joint_visit_values_read": False,
            "v2_joint_results_directory_read": False,
            "v2_joint_visit_values_read": False,
            "v3_joint_results_directory_read": False,
            "v3_joint_visit_values_read": False,
            "v4_joint_results_directory_read": False,
            "v4_joint_visit_values_read": False,
            "margin_computed": False,
            "trajectory_built": False,
            "selector_invoked": False,
            "server_pull_performed": False,
            "rng_draws": 0,
        },
        "joint_data_eligibility": {
            "eligible_campaign": campaign.COLLECTION_PREFIX,
            "eligible_calibration_waves": list(campaign.CALIBRATION_WAVES),

        "action_mapping": mappings,

        ],

            "A one-future-visit 95% joint upper-time audit and conditional local "
            "complete-frame capacity calculation based only on the independent "
            "joint95-v5 19+1 cohort. It is not time-uniform physical coverage, a "
            "trajectory result, or candidate-search closure without separate "

def register(output: Path = DEFAULT_REGISTRATION, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    output = Path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ClosureRefusal(f"registration artifact already exists: {output}")
    protocol = build_registration(**kwargs)
    base._write_new(output, protocol)
    return protocol


def _current_source_snapshot(protocol: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    paths = protocol.get("source_paths") or {}
    manifest = base._read_object(Path(paths["collection_manifest"]))
    collection = _collection_contract(
        manifest, results_dir=Path(paths["joint_results_directory"])
    )
    anchor = base._predictor_anchor(manifest)
    lcb_protocol = base._read_object(Path(paths["lcb_envelope_protocol"]))
    count_protocol = base._read_object(Path(paths["count_space_trajectory_protocol"]))
    count_result = base._read_object(Path(paths["count_space_trajectory_result"]))
    point_model = base._model_from_snapshot(lcb_protocol.get("point_model") or {})
    mappings = base._action_mapping(lcb_protocol, anchor)
    candidate_source = base._candidate_source_snapshot(count_protocol, count_result)
    return {
        "manifest": manifest,
        "collection_contract": collection,
        "predictor_anchor": anchor,
        "point_model": point_model,
        "point_reference_model": base._json(point_model.snapshot()),
        "action_mapping": mappings,
        "candidate_evidence_source": candidate_source,
    }


def _validate_registered_sources(
    protocol: Mapping[str, Any], current: Mapping[str, Any]
) -> None:
    checks = (
        ("v5 collection contract", current["collection_contract"], protocol.get("collection_contract")),
        ("predictor anchor", current["predictor_anchor"], protocol.get("predictor_anchor")),
        ("point reference model", current["point_reference_model"], protocol.get("point_reference_model")),
        ("action mapping", current["action_mapping"], protocol.get("action_mapping")),
        ("candidate evidence source", current["candidate_evidence_source"], protocol.get("candidate_evidence_source")),
    )
    for label, actual, expected in checks:
        if actual != expected:
            raise ClosureRefusal(f"{label} changed after registration")
    point_model = current["point_model"]
    baseline_model, baseline_envelopes = base._planned_baseline_model(
        point_model,
        current["predictor_anchor"],
        current["action_mapping"],
        margin=0.0,
    )
    if base._json(baseline_envelopes) != protocol.get("zero_margin_action_envelopes"):
        raise ClosureRefusal("zero-margin action-envelope contract changed")
    if base._reference_capacity_contract(point_model) != protocol.get(
        "fixed_capacity_contract"
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal("fixed capacity direction or roster changed")
    if base._registration_candidate_audit(
        point_model, baseline_model
    ) != protocol.get("candidate_evidence_reuse_pre_audit"):
        raise ClosureRefusal("candidate-evidence reuse pre-audit changed")
    paths = protocol.get("source_paths") or {}
    results_dir = Path(paths["joint_results_directory"]).resolve()
    if Path(paths["holdout_release"]).resolve() != results_dir / "holdout_release.json":
        raise ClosureRefusal("holdout release path is outside the frozen v5 results directory")
    eligibility = protocol.get("joint_data_eligibility") or {}
    if eligibility != {
        "eligible_campaign": campaign.COLLECTION_PREFIX,
        "eligible_calibration_waves": list(campaign.CALIBRATION_WAVES),
        "eligible_holdout_wave": campaign.HOLDOUT_WAVE,
        "v1_joint_units_used": 0,
        "v1_joint_scores_used": 0,
        "v1_joint_results_read": 0,
        "v2_joint_units_used": 0,
        "v2_joint_scores_used": 0,
        "v2_joint_results_read": 0,
        "v3_joint_units_used": 0,
        "v3_joint_scores_used": 0,
        "v3_joint_results_read": 0,
        "v4_joint_units_used": 0,
        "v4_joint_scores_used": 0,
        "v4_joint_results_read": 0,
    }:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5-only joint-data eligibility changed")


def _complete_v5_joint_evidence(
    protocol: Mapping[str, Any], manifest: Mapping[str, Any]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    results_dir = Path((protocol.get("source_paths") or {})["joint_results_directory"])
    fail_stop = dispatcher._campaign_fail_stop(results_dir)
    if fail_stop is not None:
        raise ClosureRefusal("v5 campaign fail-stop sentinel is active")
    foreign = dispatcher._foreign_result_paths(manifest, results_dir)
    if foreign:
        raise ClosureRefusal(
            "v1-v4 or unregistered result artifacts are present in the v5 results directory"
        )
    scans = dispatcher._scan_results(manifest, results_dir)
    for wave in (*campaign.CALIBRATION_WAVES, campaign.HOLDOUT_WAVE):
        scan = scans.get(wave) or {}
        attempts = list(scan.get("attempts") or [])
        successes = list(scan.get("successes") or [])
        if len(attempts) != 1 or len(successes) != 1:
            raise ClosureRefusal(
                f"v5 wave {wave} requires exactly one passing first attempt; "
                f"found {len(attempts)} attempts and {len(successes)} valid PASS terminals"
            )
    release_path = Path((protocol.get("source_paths") or {})["holdout_release"])
    try:
        release = dispatcher._read_object(release_path)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ClosureRefusal(
            f"explicit v5 holdout release is unavailable: {exc}"
        ) from exc
    release_audit = dispatcher.validate_holdout_release(release, manifest, scans)
    if release_audit.get("pass") is not True:
        raise ClosureRefusal(
            "explicit v5 holdout release is invalid: "
            + "; ".join(str(value) for value in release_audit.get("errors") or [])
        )

    anchor = protocol.get("predictor_anchor") or []
    calibration = []
    for wave in campaign.CALIBRATION_WAVES:
        row = scans[wave]["successes"][0]
        calibration.append(
            {
                "path": str(row["path"]),
                **base._score_success(row["payload"], anchor),
            }
        )
    holdout_row = scans[campaign.HOLDOUT_WAVE]["successes"][0]
    holdout = {
        "path": str(holdout_row["path"]),
        **base._score_success(holdout_row["payload"], anchor),
    }
    try:
        released_at = float(release["released_at"])
        holdout_started_at = float(holdout_row["payload"]["started_at"])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ClosureRefusal(
            "v5 release/holdout sequencing times are unavailable"
        ) from exc
    if (
        not math.isfinite(released_at)
        or not math.isfinite(holdout_started_at)
        or holdout_started_at < released_at
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal(
            f"v5 wave {campaign.HOLDOUT_WAVE} is not an independent post-release holdout"
        )
    scores = [row["joint_wave_score"] for row in calibration]
    raw_rank_score, margin = base._rank19_margin(scores)
    frozen_margin = float(release_audit["frozen_margin"])
    if not math.isclose(
        margin,
        frozen_margin,
        rel_tol=base.TOLERANCE,
        abs_tol=base.TOLERANCE,
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal(
            "v5 release did not freeze the recomputed rank-19 margin"
        )
    return {
        "calibration": calibration,
        "calibration_joint_scores": scores,
        "raw_rank19_score": raw_rank_score,
        "one_sided_margin": margin,
        "release": {
            "path": str(release_path),
            "released_at": released_at,
            "finite_sample_rank": release.get("finite_sample_rank"),
            "calibration_margin_frozen": release.get(
                "calibration_margin_frozen"
            ),
            "frozen_margin": frozen_margin,
            "v1_joint_units_used": int(release.get("v1_joint_units_used", -1)),
            "audit_passed": True,
        },
        "holdout": holdout,
        "holdout_started_at": holdout_started_at,
        "holdout_covered": holdout["joint_wave_score"] <= margin + base.TOLERANCE,
    }


def run_registered(
    registration: Path = DEFAULT_REGISTRATION,
    output: Path = DEFAULT_RESULT,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    registration = Path(registration)
    output = Path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ClosureRefusal(f"result artifact already exists: {output}")
    protocol = base._read_object(registration)
    if (
        protocol.get("schema_version") != 1
        or protocol.get("gate") != GATE
        or protocol.get("experiment") != EXPERIMENT
        or protocol.get("registered") is not True
        or protocol.get("status") != STATUS
        or protocol.get("decision_rule") != DECISION_RULE
    ):
        raise ClosureRefusal("joint95-v5 closure registration is invalid")
    current = _current_source_snapshot(protocol)
    _validate_registered_sources(protocol, current)
    joint = _complete_v5_joint_evidence(protocol, current["manifest"])
    envelope_model, envelopes = base._planned_baseline_model(
        current["point_model"],
        protocol["predictor_anchor"],
        protocol["action_mapping"],
        margin=float(joint["one_sided_margin"]),
    )
    capacity = base._capacity_analysis(protocol, envelope_model)
    candidate = base._candidate_support_audit(protocol, envelope_model, capacity)
    decision = base._decision(
        bool(joint["holdout_covered"]),
        bool(capacity["all_registered_capacity_margins_positive"]),
        str(candidate["status"]),
    )
    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "gate": GATE,
        "experiment": EXPERIMENT,
        "status": "PASS",
        "registration_path": str(registration.resolve()),
        "protocol": protocol,
        "joint95_v5_audit": joint,
        "physical_complete_frame_envelope": {
            "model": envelope_model.snapshot(),
            "actions": envelopes,
        },
        "capacity": capacity,
        "candidate_support": candidate,
        "scientific_decision": decision,
        "closure_passed": decision == "JOINT95_ALIGNED_CAPACITY_CLOSURE_PASS",
        "capacity_established": bool(
            joint["holdout_covered"]
            and capacity["all_registered_capacity_margins_positive"]
        ),
        "joint_data_accounting": {
            "v5_calibration_units": len(joint["calibration"]),
            "v5_holdout_units": 1,
            "v1_joint_units": 0,
            "v1_joint_scores": 0,
            "v2_joint_units": 0,
            "v2_joint_scores": 0,
            "v3_joint_units": 0,
            "v3_joint_scores": 0,
            "v4_joint_units": 0,
            "v4_joint_scores": 0,
        },
        "trajectory_runs": 0,
        "selector_calls": 0,
        "server_pulls": 0,
        "rng_draws": 0,
        "claim_boundary": protocol["claim_boundary"],
    }
    base._write_new(output, report)
    return report


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    register_parser = sub.add_parser("register")
    register_parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_REGISTRATION)
    register_parser.add_argument(
        "--collection-manifest", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_COLLECTION_MANIFEST
    )
    register_parser.add_argument("--results-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_RESULTS_DIR)
    register_parser.add_argument("--lcb-protocol", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_LCB_PROTOCOL)
    register_parser.add_argument("--count-protocol", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_COUNT_PROTOCOL)
    register_parser.add_argument("--count-result", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_COUNT_RESULT)
    run_parser = sub.add_parser("run")
    run_parser.add_argument("--registration", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_REGISTRATION)
    run_parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_RESULT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.command == "register":
            report = register(
                args.output,
                collection_manifest_path=args.collection_manifest,
                results_dir=args.results_dir,
                lcb_protocol_path=args.lcb_protocol,
                count_protocol_path=args.count_protocol,
                count_result_path=args.count_result,
            )
        else:
            report = run_registered(args.registration, args.output)
    except ClosureRefusal as exc:
        parser.error(str(exc))
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class BudgetFrontierRefusal(RuntimeError):
    """The registered development frontier contract is not satisfied."""


def _json(value: Any) -> Any:
    return json.loads(json.dumps(value))


def _read_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        value = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise BudgetFrontierRefusal(f"cannot read JSON object {path}: {exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise BudgetFrontierRefusal(f"JSON root must be an object: {path}")
    return value


def _write_new(path: Path, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(dict(payload), stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")

    lane_rows = result.get("lane_summaries") or ()
    by_lane = {row.get("lanes"): row for row in lane_rows}
    checks = result.get("checks") or {}
    if (
        result.get("schema_version") != 1
        or result.get("gate") != source.GATE
        or result.get("experiment") != source.EXPERIMENT
        or result.get("status") != "PASS"
        or result.get("protocol") != protocol
        or result.get("scientific_decision") != SOURCE_DECISION
        or result.get("trajectory_registration_prerequisite_passed") is not False
        or result.get("capacity_closure_reclassified") is not False
        or result.get("retained_v5_capacity_established") is not False
        or result.get("retained_v5_closure_passed") is not False
        or not checks
        or not all(checks.values())
        or set(by_lane) != set(LANE_BUDGETS)
        or by_lane[8].get("fixed_lp_budget") != 36
        or by_lane[8].get("support_gate_passed") is not False
        or by_lane[8].get("actual_compute_gate_passed") is not True
        or by_lane[16].get("fixed_lp_budget") != 72
        or by_lane[16].get("support_gate_passed") is not True
        or by_lane[16].get("actual_compute_gate_passed") is not False
